Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīvatthu Part 2: Celestial rebirth, father's weeping at tomb, debate, Buddha's utterance of Verse 2 ('Manopubbaṅgamā dhammā... tato naṃ sukhamanveti...'), and word-by-word commentary on Verse 2.
Tissattheravatthu (Verses 3-4 'Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ...') and Kāḷayakkhinīvatthu (Verse 5 'Na hi verena verāni...'). Completes 100% of s0502a.att (236 paras)!
Pārājikapāḷi: Sudinna, Verañjakaṇḍa, and the Vinaya codes.
